design_document: Create hello.txt containing Hello EHAI and one LF newline. Only hello.txt may change. A read-only Reviewer checks the delivered file; the host runs the existing, immutable verify.py. No network, package installation or Git writes by Agents. On missing prerequisites, request human intervention without changing acceptance.

nodes.title: Write hello.txt
nodes.instruction: Create hello.txt containing exactly Hello EHAI followed by one LF. Modify no other files. Do not change verify.py. Submit the actual code artifact using the host finish tool.

nodes.title: Review hello.txt
nodes.instruction: Read the prepared upstream artifact and verify hello.txt contains exactly Hello EHAI plus LF. Do not modify files. Return the host review format and evidence for every supplied artifact; the host owns the Gate decision.
